name: 7-spiroindanyloxymorphone
summary: 7-Spiroindanyloxymorphone (SIOM) is a drug that is used in scientific research. It is a selective δ-opioid agonist. It is a derivative of oxymorphone.

pharmacology.text: It is a selective δ-opioid agonist.

uses.text: 7-Spiroindanyloxymorphone (SIOM) is a drug that is used in scientific research.

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. It is a laboratory tool rather than a drug people take. Drugs acting on the δ-opioid receptor have been linked to seizures in animal studies.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。它是實驗室工具，而不是供人使用的藥物。在動物研究中，作用於δ鴉片受體的藥物曾與癲癇發作有關。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。它是实验室工具，而不是供人使用的药物。在动物研究中，作用于δ鸦片受体的药物曾与癫痫发作有关。

fact.en: It carries a spiro junction, where two rings meet at a single shared carbon atom and sit at right angles to each other. That rigid shape is what makes it pick out the δ-opioid receptor.
fact.zh: 它帶有一個螺環接點，也就是兩個環共用同一個碳原子、彼此互相垂直。正是這種僵硬的形狀，讓它能挑選出δ鴉片受體。
fact.zhHans: 它带有一个螺环接点，也就是两个环共用同一个碳原子、彼此互相垂直。正是这种僵硬的形状，让它能挑选出δ鸦片受体。
